numinance.kinds.v1.Indexer.jsonschema.st.description: Indexer is one indexer provider and what it covers.

edge_overlays.description: edge_overlays is the edge overlays added to the graph.

languages.description: languages is the languages the provider indexes.

provider.description: provider is required: the extension id of an indexer port provider.

numinance.kinds.v1.Indexer.jsonschema.st.title: Indexer

numinance.kinds.v1.IndexerPlugin.jsonsch.description: IndexerPlugin is how the code graph is built.

extensions.description: extensions holds vendor or customer data under reverse-DNS keys; the Engine never reads it.

metadata.description: metadata is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

spec.description: spec is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.IndexerPlugin.jsonsch.title: Indexer Plugin

numinance.kinds.v1.IndexerPluginSpec.jso.description: IndexerPluginSpec lists the indexers that build the code graph.

indexers.description: indexers is required and non-empty; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.IndexerPluginSpec.jso.title: Indexer Plugin Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.description: Metadata names a kind object and fixes its scope.

name.description: name is required and unique per kind and scope; other kinds reference the object by it.

scope.description: scope is required and not SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED; the loader enforces the latter.
